INDIA bloc holds Ramlila Maidan rally amid heavy security

The INDIA bloc held a rally at Ramlila Maidan today, with approximately 10,000 security personnel deployed and 250 CCTV cameras installed for surveillance. In response, the BJP organized a "padyatra" (foot march).
